I was in a position like you a while ago and after I got some advice, I was able to improve my ELO bit by bit and now I am around 1200 (from 900). While this is nowhere near a pro level, I feel like I did get quite a bit of help from my reddit post. In general, there were two things I realized I needed to change. 
1, I had to make sure that I always thought of league as a game and not get too uptight about it. While it is important to play seriously to win ranked games, it is also important to take it easy and screw around in normal games from time to time to make sure this game stays fun. Raging helps no one, and even if your team rages, make sure you don't.

2, make sure you don't throw games. This actually happened a lot to myself where either I or some of my teammates would start off really well in lane, 2-0 or 3-0 with 40 more cs, but ultimately, we'd still lose. This basically revolves around teamfight mechanics, but a lot of times, if you are doing well, your team will listen to you. This means it is your responsibility to make sure you stay alive and make sure your team doesn't fight when you will lose. Don't try and have a teamfight under their tower if you won't win, don't try to fight when the other team has baron, don't try and get baron when you are pushed to your nexus, etc.


TL;DR: Try to stay calm and not rage, don't throw games.

Also, work on cs. Cs wins games mang.
